# Stronger universal practical warrant target / 普遍实践权威的更强目标

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`universal-practical-warrant` · **open** · target · F08 · [record](universal-practical-warrant.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Target: universal practical warrant with zero substantive axioms, developed as one account of ends, selection, knowing, normativity and revision within becoming.
>
> 目标：取得零实质公理的普遍实践根据，并在同一生成活动中统一解释目的、选择、认识、规范及修订。

## Progress / 已接通

1. Source and address of a reason: a response-specific argument separates what makes a change worth considering, why it bears on a given response and how much can be required, tested against formed-boundary restriction.<br>理由的来源与适用：针对回应的论证分开变化为何值得考虑、为何关涉特定回应、可要求多少，并以形成边界的限制作对照检验。 [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ZERO-AXIOM-PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT-INTEGRATION.md#nonexclusive-response-ground)
2. Purpose revision: one revision can both recognize a prior ground and create new reasons, so its success alone does not discriminate between them; pre-commitment practical support is refined against its strongest objection.<br>目的修订：同一次修订可兼有认识已有根据与创造新理由，其成功因此不能单独裁决两者；承诺形成前的实践支持经最强反审细化。 [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ZERO-AXIOM-PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT-INTEGRATION.md#purpose-revision-and-prior-warrant)
3. Normative differentiation in one activity: the separate-domain architecture is withdrawn; completed repair can change a response’s purpose and ending, and representational omission, actual suppression and informed harm are distinguished.<br>同一活动中的规范分化：撤回分立领域的架构；完成的修复可以改变回应的目的与结束条件，并区分表示遗漏、实际压制与知情维持伤害。 [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ZERO-AXIOM-PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT-INTEGRATION.md#normative-differentiation-within-activity)
4. Restrictions compared: what a boundary does in actual living, not its existence, is assessed; historical necessity does not settle present justification, and purported alternatives also need actual support.<br>限制的比较：评价的是边界在实际生活关系中的作用，而非边界的存在；历史必要性不自行裁决当前正当性，所称替代也须有实际支持。 [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ZERO-AXIOM-PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT-INTEGRATION.md#226-实际比较限制怎样保护或阻碍展开)
5. One theory: following Ren, existing capture and revision results, at their scopes, explain purposes, knowing, normativity and response in the same organization; informed harm tests guarantees of goodwill and is no normative counterexample.<br>一个理论：依Ren，以既有捕获与修订结果（各按原范围）在同一组织中说明目的、认识、规范与回应；知情伤害检验对善意的保证，不是规范反例。 [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ZERO-AXIOM-PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT-INTEGRATION.md#one-theory-selection-and-normativity)
6. Selective correction: method success and harmful reproduction can coexist, so technical learning does not itself warrant ends; the test asks whether actual fulfillment can change tasks, selection and endings, not always requiring exit.<br>选择性纠正：方法的成功可与有害再生产并存，技术学习因此不独自证成目的；检验问实际实现能否改变任务、选择与结束条件，不无条件要求退出。 [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ZERO-AXIOM-PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT-INTEGRATION.md#selective-correction-and-formed-ends)
7. Fulfillment test: five conceptual cases narrow it to a local diagnostic, as actual reorganization can perpetuate capture; it now follows actual affected relations, grounds for retaining or changing arrangements, and concrete responses.<br>检验完成问句：五项概念检验将其收窄为局部诊断，因为真实改组仍可延续俘获；修正后追踪实际受影响关系、保持或改变安排的根据及具体回应。 [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/ZERO-AXIOM-PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT-INTEGRATION.md#fulfillment-test-counterreview)

## Conditions / 条件

- An independently authorized stronger target; supplied local norms or behavioral convergence do not substitute for it.<br>独立获授权的更强目标；不得以局部给定规范或行为收敛替代。

## Does not show / 未表明

- Repair fidelity and historical necessity alone do not refute an openly controlling end; real needs, transition losses, protective boundaries and informed harm remain.<br>修复内容及历史必要性的分析不能单独反驳一个明确追求控制的目标；真实需要、转型损失、保护性边界和知情伤害均保留。
- Fuller description alone is no ethical proof.<br>不能以补全描述直接宣告伦理成立。
- No positive weight is preassigned to every added option, and not every removable restriction is judged to require removal.<br>不给所有选项增加预置正权重，不证明所有可解除限制均应解除。
- No complete ordering of mixed outcomes is given.<br>不给出完整的混合排序。
- A purpose’s formation history does not by itself invalidate it.<br>目的有形成史，不自动使它无效。
- The fulfillment test cannot certify goodness or release from capture: declared beneficiaries do not exhaust affected living, and harm before completion also matters.<br>原完成检验不能单独认证善或脱离俘获：受益者不能只按宣称限定，未完成时的损伤也需评估。
- Retaining an arrangement may be warranted, and nominal revisability is not enactment.<br>保持安排未必失当，名义可修订不等于实行。
- The revised question is itself an inquiry: it substitutes for no normative argument and cannot prove warrant by defining it in.<br>修正版问句本身仍是研究问题：不替代规范论证，也不能把“有根据”写入定义来证明它。

**Standard boundaries / 通用边界:** The nondual method is a requirement of method, not a proof of ontology or ethical necessity. 非二元是方法要求，不是本体或伦理必然性的证明。 · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account. 较弱描述省略某一关系，不构成对较完整说明的反驳。 · Premise-free (zero-substantive-axiom) grounding is a separate open target; completed G0/J results keep their scope. 无实质公理奠基是另一开放目标；已完成的 G0/J 成果保持原范围。

## Evidence / 证据

Philosophical argument with substantive author counterreview and five conceptual stress tests; full or targeted rereadings of existing studies (elective concern, relation and reason, the noninstrumental root, relational goodness, whole-process realization, the constitutive audit, ethical learning) and of the capture, registration and plan-revision records; a bounded rereading of an already used primary source. The independent evaluator review and conditional proofs are reused at their scopes. No new mathematical claim, formal composition, Lean run, empirical result or independent acceptance.<br>哲学论证、实质作者反审及五项概念压力检验；完整或定向重读既有研究（选择关切、关系与理由、非工具性根基、关系善、整体实现、构成审计、伦理学习）及捕获、登记与计划修订记录；有限复读已用原典的指定段落。复用既有评价者独立审查及条件证明，各按原范围。无新数学命题、形式组合、Lean运行、经验结果或独立验收。

## Next / 下一步

Directly explain how actual affected living supports judgments to retain, change or end arrangements, preserving substantive contrary grounds and implementation barriers.<br>直接解释实际受影响生活怎样支持保持、改变或结束安排的判断，保留具体反向根据及实行障碍。

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history / 对应、依赖、来源与沿革</summary>

### Correspondence / 对应

Begin with formation, obstruction, sensing, response and transformation; explain positions and analytic distinctions relationally. Distinguish representational omission, actual suppression and informed maintenance of harm. A boundary’s role changes with living relations; descriptive completeness does not itself prove normative validity. Universality is not equal duties, compliance or full Unrestricted significance.<br>先展开形成、受阻、察觉、回应与转型；位置和分析区分由关系说明。区分表示遗漏、实际压制与知情维持伤害；边界的实际作用随生活关系变化，完整描述不自动证明规范成立。普遍性不等于同责、遵循或全部Unrestricted断言。
